question: Calculate the win percentage of Jake when he starts Patrick Mahomes.

sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.outcome = 'Win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) as win_rate FROM Fact_Player_Performance_Weekly p JOIN Fact_Matchup_History_Wide m ON p.season_id = m.season_id AND p.game_week = m.nfl_week AND p.owner_name = m.manager_name WHERE p.player_name = 'Patrick Mahomes' AND p.owner_name = 'Jake' AND p.is_starting = 1
answer: Jake has a win percentage of {{win_rate}} when starting Patrick Mahomes.
